events.title: DEMO Update - Localization & Enemy unlocks and more
events.summary: Pest Protocol - 0.3.1Small but mighty update! This one's focused on three things: making the game speak your language, making enemy progression feel earned, and tightening up the economy.🌐 i18n — New Language SupportThe game is now fully playable in Chinese (中文), with English as the default. A new language dropdown in Settings lets you switch anytime, and all UI text, shop upgrades, enemy names, and reports translate live. We also shipped a custom font fallback so CJK characters render crisply.
